chunks: ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥasan, from Ayyūb ibn Nūḥ, from Muḥammad ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from Abī al-Ḥasan عليه السلام.
Concerning a man performing wudu (ablution) with the leftover water of a menstruating woman.
He said: “If she is trustworthy, then there is no harm.”

key_terms.فَلَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; it is permissible

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform wudu (ablution) with the leftover water of a menstruating woman?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on using the leftover water of a menstruating woman for wudu (ablution). It states that there is no problem in doing so if she is trustworthy, indicating the permissibility of such water in ritual purity under that condition.
